correctness.rationale: For passive-image idempotents, the homomorphism law with second input 0 forces f(sigma(x))=f(x); idempotence then makes the image a partial transversal. Every nonempty partial transversal admits exactly s^(r-s+1) retractions by free choices on omitted cycles and f(0). The induced face polynomial is product(1+d_i z)-1. Its elementary symmetric coefficients, or the map polynomial after explicit division, recover all cycle lengths. Exhaustive direct homomorphism checks cover 13 nonidentity profiles through five positive points. Finite checks are ancillary.

value.rationale: The passive-image stratum is characterized intrinsically by omission of the unique nontrivial right-translation point, not by an arbitrary numerical slice. It yields an exact image-poset classification, exact retraction multiplicity per embedded image, and a complete numerical invariant of conjugacy type, even when the standard quandle polynomial fails to distinguish cycle types. This quantitative relation to the published isomorphism and Hom theory is a motivated classification.
